title: ‘The Odyssey’ Was Made for Imax 70mm. Good Luck Watching It That Way
summary: That’s partly because The Odyssey is the first feature film shot entirely on Imax film with Imax cameras. The result, though, has been notably different Imax experiences depending on what type of Imax theater you’re in.
